name: ashley-wsu
description: Sets up a medical student's laptop for research on the Wayne State HPC grid: SSH through the login node to a compute node, tokens for GitHub, Hugging Face and Claude, a persistent Claude Code worker in a Singularity container on the grid, and a bridge so the Claude Code extension can send it work.

commands.title: Open my grid files on a compute node (Remote-SSH)
Start a Claude worker on the grid
Phone access: drive a grid worker from the Claude app
Install or update Ashley on the grid (job)
Lab access to the shared library (request or manage)
Connect the Claude Code extension to the grid (MCP)
Store or replace my Claude token for the grid
Open a terminal on the grid login node
Reset this laptop (emulate a fresh install)

viewsWelcome.contents:
Ashley connects this laptop to the Wayne State grid and to a Claude Code worker running there.

[Set up my research environment](command:ashley.setup)

[Open the manual](command:ashley.openManual)

walkthroughs.title: Ashley: research on the Wayne State grid
walkthroughs.description: From a fresh laptop to a Claude worker on the grid, in one panel.

steps.title: Run the setup wizard
steps.description:
AccessID, SSH key, sign-ins and tokens, and the grid install, in one panel.
[Run the wizard](command:ashley.setup)

steps.title: Start a Claude worker
steps.description:
A Slurm job that keeps a Claude Code session alive for you.
[Start a worker](command:ashley.workerStart)

steps.title: Open your grid files
steps.description:
Browse, edit and view images on the compute node with Remote-SSH.
[Connect](command:ashley.connect)

steps.title: Let Claude Code use the grid
steps.description:
Register the bridge so the Claude Code extension can dispatch work.
[Register](command:ashley.registerMcp)

ashley.accessId.description: Your Wayne State AccessID (set by the wizard's Wayne State sign-in).

ashley.loginHost.description: The grid login node. Used only as an SSH jump host; nothing heavy runs there.

ashley.sshAlias.description: The Host alias written to ~/.ssh/config for the login node.

ashley.nodeDomain.description: Domain suffix of compute nodes (voh3 -> voh3.nas.grid.wayne.edu).

ashley.identityFile.description: SSH private key used for the grid.

ashley.gridRoot.description: Where large files live on the grid (container, npm prefix, workspaces). Empty = /rs/rs_grp_oschome/<AccessID>/ashley when that volume is writable, else ~/ashley.

ashley.worker.partition.description: Slurm partition for the Claude worker job.

ashley.worker.qos.description: QoS for the worker. requeue is the shared pool (job may be requeued; the worker resumes); primary is dedicated.

ashley.worker.hours.description: Wall time of the worker job in hours.

ashley.worker.gpu.description: GPUs for the worker job (0 = CPU node). With a GPU the partition becomes gmsap,gvohp,galhp and the QoS gpu.

ashley.worker.concurrency.description: How many prompts the worker runs at once.

ashley.defaultSession.description: Session name used by 'Ask the grid Claude' (a session is a resumable conversation).

ashley.injectTokensIntoTerminals.description: Put GITHUB_TOKEN and HF_TOKEN into every integrated terminal. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is never injected: it would switch the local Claude Code from your subscription to pay-per-use.

ashley.container.description: Which lab container a new worker runs: 'auto' = the lab's default, or the name of another container your lead published.

ashley.twoFactorDone.description: Set by the wizard once you confirmed a grid account with Google Authenticator (or once the grid accepted this laptop's key).

ashley.wsuEmail.description: The Wayne State account you signed in with (set by the wizard's first step).

ashley.allowlistUrl.description: Optional: where a newer list of the lab's pre-approved AccessIDs is published (JSON {"accessIds": [...]}). Empty = the list shipped with this build.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:vscode
